observations: body L2: between «τοῦ» and «κρατοῦσι» a low numeral sign and a high numeral sign are printed side by side (͵ʹ), with no letter between them, after a wide space.
body L5: «τέϑεικε» is printed with the open theta ϑ, «ἔθηκε» with the closed θ; transcribed as printed. Kappa is printed in the curly form throughout (κ).
body L28-L29: «minu-/nutorum» is printed so (the syllable nu repeated across the line break).
body L33: the A of «apogeo A» is printed without its crossbar and looks like Λ.
